# Vertical Automotive

> Vertical Automotive is a Fort Lauderdale and Wilton Manors-based auto repair shop specializing in advanced diagnostics, Tesla repair, European vehicles, and complete automotive service for all makes and models. Known for its 5-star reputation, transparent service approach, and diagnostic-first philosophy, Vertical Automotive serves South Florida drivers with a focus on accuracy, reliability, and long-term vehicle performance.

## Business

- **Name:** Vertical Automotive
- **Type:** Auto Repair Shop (ASE-Certified)
- **Locations:** Fort Lauderdale, FL and Wilton Manors, FL
- **Founded:** 1989
- **Experience:** 36+ years, 54,000+ vehicles serviced
- **Rating:** 5-star (500+ Google reviews)
- **Warranty:** 36-month / 36,000-mile on all repairs

## Services

- Advanced Engine Diagnostics
- Tesla & Electric Vehicle Repair
- European Vehicle Specialists (BMW, Mercedes, Audi, Porsche, Volvo)
- Brake Service & Repair
- Transmission Service
- A/C Repair & Service
- Oil Change & Preventive Maintenance
- Wheel Alignment & Tires
- Electrical System Diagnostics
- Hybrid Vehicle Service

## Philosophy

Vertical Automotive operates as a diagnostic-first shop. Rather than replacing parts speculatively, technicians identify the root cause of every issue before recommending any repair. The goal is accuracy, transparency, and long-term reliability — not speed or volume.
